headline.en: Inspect tensor structure before loading a checkpoint.
headline.zh: 加载检查点之前先检查张量结构。

sub.en: TensorSentry reads tensor names, dtypes and shapes, compares them with a declared profile, and reports structural anomalies.
sub.zh: TensorSentry 读取张量名称、dtype 与 shape，与声明配置比较并报告结构异常。

body.en: Shape checks do not require inference execution.
body.zh: shape 检查无需执行推理。

body.en: Profiles make required tensor constraints explicit.
body.zh: 配置明确必须满足的张量约束。

body.en: Structure, exploit and provenance statuses have different meanings.
body.zh: 结构、攻击与来源状态各自表达不同含义。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Generate a tiny safetensors file in a temporary directory, check its explicit shape profile, then show the missing-tensor rejection on an empty input.
note.zh: 在临时目录生成微型 safetensors 文件，检查明确的 shape 配置，再展示空输入的缺失张量拒绝。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: A tiny real F32 safetensors file and an explicit demo-only profile exercise header parsing and structural validation. No model-specific profile accuracy, exploit scan or provenance verification is claimed.

body.en: Generate a tiny safetensors file in a temporary directory, check its explicit shape profile, then show the missing-tensor rejection on an empty input.
body.zh: 在临时目录生成微型 safetensors 文件，检查明确的 shape 配置，再展示空输入的缺失张量拒绝。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/tensorsentry.git
cd tensorsentry
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: Profiles are repository declarations and must be checked against your exact checkpoint architecture; a named profile does not establish current vendor specifications.
limitations.zh: 配置是仓库中的声明，需要与实际检查点架构核对；配置名称不等于当前厂商规格已获验证。

limitations.en: A structural pass does not prove provenance, numerical correctness or absence of every exploit. Provenance verification is not implemented.
limitations.zh: 结构通过不证明来源、数值正确性或不存在所有攻击；来源验证尚未实现。

limitations.en: The demo uses a custom demo-only profile and a tiny valid tensor file. It does not evaluate real model weights or pickle detection.
limitations.zh: 示例使用演示专用配置与微型有效张量文件，不评估真实模型权重或 pickle 检测。

body.en: A model loader can fail late when a checkpoint has missing projections or mismatched shapes. Metadata checks surface these disagreements before the main load path allocates model tensors.
body.zh: 检查点缺少投影或 shape 不匹配，可能直到加载时才报错。元数据检查可以在主加载链路分配模型张量前暴露这些差异。

body.en: Container readers expose a common tensor view. The structural validator applies TensorProfile requirements, including declared MoE and MLA constraints. The scanner combines structure with the pickle scanner adapter; provenance is currently a separate unimplemented stage.
body.zh: 容器读取器提供统一张量视图。结构验证器应用 TensorProfile 要求，包括声明的 MoE 与 MLA 约束。scanner 将结构结果与 pickle 扫描适配器组合；provenance 当前是独立的未实现阶段。

body.en: Container readers expose a common tensor view. The structural validator applies TensorProfile requirements, including declared MoE and MLA constraints. The scanner combines structure with the pickle scanner adapter; provenance is currently a separate unimplemented stage.
body.zh: 容器读取器提供统一张量视图。结构验证器应用 TensorProfile 要求，包括声明的 MoE 与 MLA 约束。scanner 将结构结果与 pickle 扫描适配器组合；provenance 当前是独立的未实现阶段。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Select a registered profile only after comparing its assumptions with the actual model. The Python API accepts an explicit TensorProfile, which the demo uses for a two-value F32 tensor. The header parser does not load a model into an inference runtime.
body.zh: 注册配置应在与实际模型假设核对后选择。Python API 接受显式 TensorProfile，示例用它检查含两个 F32 值的张量。头解析器不会把模型加载进推理运行时。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
tensorsentry profiles
tensorsentry validate <profile-id> model.safetensors
tensorsentry scan --model <profile-id> ./checkpoint --json
